limitations_and_boundaries: The method assumes no hidden variables.
The acyclicity constraint is adapted from the linear case and relies on the implication that zero neural network path implies zero graph edge.
The augmented Lagrangian approach provides approximate solutions that converge to a stationary point under regularity conditions.
The synthetic experiments assume Gaussian additive noise models with known parametric form.
The real-world dataset is small (11 nodes, 17 edges).

experiments_or_tasks: Adapt the acyclicity constraint to the nonlinear model by applying it at the level of neural network paths and then graph paths.
Compare GraN-DAG against continuous baselines (DAG-GNN, NOTEARS) and discrete baselines (CAM, RANDOM) using SHD and SID metrics.
Develop GraN-DAG, a score-based method for structure learning that extends NOTEARS to nonlinear relationships using neural networks.
Evaluate GraN-DAG on a real-world protein signaling dataset with 11 nodes and 17 edges.
Evaluate GraN-DAG on synthetic data with 50 nodes and an average of 200 edges, where data is generated from a Gaussian additive noise model with GP functions.
Optimize the maximum likelihood objective with the acyclicity constraint using an augmented Lagrangian approach and RMSprop.

methods.name: GraN-DAG
methods.protocol_description: GraN-DAG models each conditional distribution pi(Xi|Xπ_i) using a neural network parameterized by θ(i). The adjacency matrix Aφ is derived from the neural network paths: (Aφ)ij = 0 if θ(j) does not depend on Xi. Acyclicity is enforced via constraint h(φ) = Tr(e^{Aφ}) - d = 0. The objective is maximum log-likelihood: max_φ E[Σ_i log pi(Xi|Xπ_i; θ(i))] subject to the acyclicity constraint. Optimization uses an augmented Lagrangian method with RMSprop.

methods.name: DAG-GNN
methods.protocol_description: A nonlinear extension of NOTEARS using graph neural networks and an evidence lower bound as score.

methods.name: NOTEARS
methods.protocol_description: Linear SEM with acyclicity constraint Tr(e^{U⊙U}) - d = 0, optimized with regularized least squares.

methods.name: CAM
methods.protocol_description: Causal additive models with high-dimensional order search and penalized regression; a discrete greedy search method.
